title: Billing Hold Rule for Hardship Supplement Claims
content:
## Rule

Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), a billing hold on the held account takes off the amount in question on it from the medical debt a hardship supplement claims, leaving aside every liability posted from the claim under appeal.

**The held account** is the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account on a billing hold for a charge dispute or, when no account is on such a hold, the account on a billing hold for an itemization review (when several accounts qualify, the one listed first among the patient's accounts).

**The claim under appeal** is the Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) claim named by the most recent appeal filed on any of the patient's claims (on a same-day tie, the appeal listed first in the claim activity), while that claim is in appealed status; when there is none, nothing is left aside.

**Amount taken off.**
1. When the held account is on a charge-dispute hold, the charge of the disputed line is taken off, but never more than the held account's patient liabilities of the twelve months (claim-under-appeal postings left aside). The disputed line is the charge line named by the most recent charge-dispute inquiry on the held account (on a tie in creation time, the inquiry listed first); when no such inquiry names a charge line, that charge is 0.00.
2. When the held account is on an itemization-review hold, its coinsurance liabilities of the twelve months (claim-under-appeal postings left aside) are taken off.
3. Otherwise nothing is taken off for a hold.

A whole month runs from a day of one month to the same day of the next month or, when the next month has no such day, to the first day of the month after it; a posting belongs to the twelve months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posting date from the signing day, so that a posting dated on the signing day's day of the month twelve months earlier is already outside.

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

| Held account | Figures | Taken off |
|---|---|---|
| charge-dispute hold; disputed line charge 900.00; account liabilities of the twelve months 600.00 | the smaller of 900.00 and 600.00 | 600.00 |
| charge-dispute hold; disputed line charge 250.00; account liabilities 600.00 | the smaller of 250.00 and 600.00 | 250.00 |
| itemization-review hold; coinsurance of the twelve months 180.00, of which 80.00 posted from the claim under appeal | 180.00 less 80.00 | 100.00 |
| no account on either hold | — | 0.00 |
